# gifenc 1.0.3 source

These are the JavaScript sources from the published [gifenc 1.0.3 npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gifenc/v/1.0.3), provided so the readable bundle in the userscript can be reviewed and the corresponding source can be obtained. Developer contact addresses were removed from a historical comment. The PnnQuant-derived file carries the upstream open-source notice. See [third-party notices](../../THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

GIF encoding uses the npm package's unminified CommonJS build inside a private wrapper. The application invokes the same encoder API as the accepted local 5.1.0 build.
